exposure: Infants with heavier birth weights and rapid growth
infant growth during the first year of life
growth trajectory (five categories) from birth to 12 months
finding: Infants with heavy birth weight and rapid growth during the first year of life were more vulnerable to the occurrence of DDE, specifically demarcated opacities, in their permanent dentition.
mod_finding: While mode of delivery was included as a confounder in the analysis, no findings specific to mode of delivery and occurrence of developmental defects of enamel were reported.
